title: Thai Star-Studded Almond Delight
description: A fusion of Thai flavors and crunchy almonds, perfect for a snack or dessert.
instructions: 2. Break the star anise into smaller pieces and toast in the oven for 5 minutes.
3. In a saucepan, combine coconut milk, sugar, and toasted star anise. Bring to a simmer over medium heat.
4. Reduce heat to low and let simmer for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
5. Stir in coconut oil and salt until dissolved.
6. Remove from heat and let cool to room temperature.
7. Refrigerate mixture for at least 2 hours or overnight.
8. Scoop mixture into individual serving cups or a large serving dish.
9. Top with toasted almond flakes, if desired.
10. Serve chilled, garnished with additional toasted almond flakes and star anise, if desired.
